description: Single source of truth for the Siren starter tag list. Read at runtime by both the C++ plugin (via rack::asset::plugin) and the Python training pipeline (via scripts/siren-tag-model/export_tag_manifest.py). Edit THIS file when adding/removing/renaming tags. Keep the entries sorted by 'name'.

tags.name: bass
tags.description: Fills the low end of a patch. Sub- or bass-register sustained or rhythmic material.

tags.name: bright
tags.description: High spectral centroid, lots of energy above ~3 kHz. Sits forward in a mix.

tags.name: dark
tags.description: Low spectral centroid, little energy above ~1 kHz. Recedes in a mix.

tags.name: drone
tags.description: Sustained, slowly evolving pitch. A held note or pad-like bed.

tags.name: field
tags.description: Field recording: environmental capture, room tone, outdoor ambience.

tags.name: lead
tags.description: Carries the melody. Sits on top of the mix, mid/high register, often rhythmic.

tags.name: loop
tags.description: Cyclical material that loops cleanly — drum loop, melodic phrase, arp.

tags.name: noise
tags.description: Broadband noise without a clear tonal component. Wind, hiss, static.

tags.name: one-shot
tags.description: Single transient event with a defined start and end. Snare hit, stab, pluck.

tags.name: pad
tags.description: Sustained chord or wash, fills the harmonic background of a patch.

tags.name: percussion
tags.description: Percussive source material with clear onsets: drum, cymbal, claps, shaker.

tags.name: stab
tags.description: Short pitched chord or hit, often used for accents or chord stabs.

tags.name: texture
tags.description: Non-pitched evolving material — granular beds, sweeping noise, risers.

tags.name: tonal
tags.description: Has a clear sense of pitch. Useful when you want to highlight pitch presence.

tags.name: vocal
tags.description: Vocal or vocal-like material: sung voice, formant tones, vowel-like resonances.
